notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary attribute-value request and response path. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies owner solicitation, provider response, ordinary attribute update/reflection metadata, transportation identity, discovery, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Request Attribute Value Update and Update Attribute Values with FederateAmbassador provider and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador updateAttributeValues and FederateAmbassador attribute callback declarations
